snippet.title: A Completely Fictional Story About a City Inside a Whale - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A Completely Fictional Story About a City Inside a Whale is out now on Steam. Travel on a wind-up boat and complete quests in the charming town of Whaleville located inside a whale.

Music by Eskimo

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445590/A_Completely_Fictional_Story_About_a_City_Inside_a_Whale




Hi everyone. This game means a lot to me. I started working on it back in 2022 after I replayed A Short Hike one day, and since then it’s gone through a lot of changes in gameplay, mood, visual style and pretty much everything. We really wanted to bring this project to life. There were a lot of ups and downs, but we’ve learned a lot along the way. I really hope you enjoy playing it.

I also want to say thanks to everyone who supported us, helped us, or simply followed this project. It truly means a lot. Thanks for watching this trailer and being here with me on my channel. Your support keeps me going and helps create more games.
